title: microvm_size_warm
question: Does a warm start lower the cost per task, once its wait is charged?
answer: No: over the microVM's whole life, 2-vCPU microVMs cost $0.108–0.120 per 1,000 tasks against $0.100–0.105 for 1 vCPU / 1 GiB. Warm, 1 vCPU / 1 GiB microVMs held 4 on c8i.xlarge, 1.0 microVMs per host vCPU; host CPU ran out.
